Why Reel The Moment

We capture more than what your event looks like. We capture how it felt.

Some moments happen once. The right photographer or videographer makes sure you can experience them again. Reel The Moment was created from more than 15 years of experience across events, customer service, styling and working closely with event professionals and suppliers.

Choosing who captures your day is personal. We help you explore portfolios and styles, find professionals servicing your area and request quotes, so the memories you keep feel like you.

About Reel The Moment

Brand essence

Life doesn't happen in poses. It happens in moments.

Reel The Moment helps people find the photographers and videographers who can preserve them. You live the moment. We'll help you find the people who capture it.

Start your enquiry
